intro.text: American Realty Investors, Inc. (the “Company”), a Nevada Corporation, is a fully integrated externally managed real estate company. We operate high quality multifamily and commercial properties throughout the Southern United States. We also invest in mortgage notes receivable and in land that is either held for appreciation or development. As used herein, the terms “ARL”, “the Company”, “We”, “Our”, or “Us” refer to the Company. As of December 31, 2025, we owned approximately 78.4% of the common stock of Transcontinental Realty Investors, Inc. ("TCI") and substantially all of our operations are conducted through TCI, whose common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the symbol “TCI”. Accordingly, we include TCI’s financial results in our consolidated financial statements.

metrics.formula: (Operating cash flow − cash CapEx) / revenue

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.formula: Operating cash flow / positive net income

metrics.label: Stock compensation / revenue
metrics.formula: Stock compensation / revenue; not an extra deduction from GAAP earnings

metrics.label: R&D / revenue
metrics.formula: R&D expense / revenue; investment intensity, not a quality verdict

metrics.label: Cash CapEx / revenue
metrics.formula: Cash CapEx / revenue; excludes noncash additions

metrics.label: Accrual ratio
metrics.formula: (Net income − operating cash flow) / average assets; not annualized

metrics.label: Return on average assets
metrics.formula: Net income / average assets; not annualized

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.formula: Current assets / current liabilities

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Loans, net of the allowance
lines.why: Lending is a bank's business: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: We rely upon the employees of Pillar to render services to us in accordance with the terms of the Advisory Agreement and the Cash Management Agreement.
We rely on third party property managers to manage the daily operations of our properties.
We rely on the information technology and systems maintained by Pillar and their employees to identify and manage material risks from cybersecurity threats.

Since we rely on accounting, financial, operational, management and other information systems, including the Internet and third-party hosted services to conduct our operations, store personal and sensitive data, process financial information and results of operations for internal reporting purposes and comply with financial reporting, legal and tax requirements, we have processes and procedures in place to monitor the prevention, detection, mitigation and remediation of cybersecurity risks.
We rely upon the employees of Pillar to render services to us in accordance with the terms of the Advisory Agreement.

Our principal sources of cash have been, and will continue to be, property operations; proceeds from land and income-producing property sales; collection of mortgage notes receivable; collections of receivables from related companies; refinancing of existing mortgage notes payable; and additional borrowings, including mortgage notes and bonds payable, and lines of credit.

We do not have any employees and rely upon Pillar for employee related services, including but not limited to asset management, legal services, accounting services, capital markets, administrative and executive services.
